newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS cuts rating trend on BCE unit Bell.
newsitem.headline: DBRS cuts rating trend on BCE unit Bell.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Thursday that it cut its rating trend on BCE Inc telephone unit Bell Canada to negative from stable.

The Toronto-based ratings agency said it confirmed Bell Canada's ratings at A (high) for debentures, A (low) for deferred interest subordinated debentures, pfd-2 for preferred shares with a stable trend and R-1 (middle) for short-term liabilities.

DBRS said it maintained the ratings but cut the trend because despite Bell's recent profit improvement, Dominion was concerned that net income would fall below target levels due to competition in local telephone service.
"As a result, growth in local revenue could slow in 1998," DBRS said. "Thereafter, growth in revenue and profits could become much more difficult."
